dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low visual prominence of pale edges along the folded primaries with soft, blurry boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Non-linear and indistinct transition; the grey plumage is continuous from the crown to the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, high-contrast white patch on the rump/upper tail coverts and multiple distinct horizontal white bands across the dark tail feathers.
